name: Office block (wide) (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: Five-storey rectangular office block, 36 x 18 m: continuous ribbon windows between precast concrete spandrels, horizontal aluminium sun louvres over the windows, a dark slab-edge band. A glazed lobby, offices and a glass-walled meeting room on the ground floor; office floors either side of a central corridor above; a core of stairs, lift and toilets with a stair to a roof door, a parapet, rooftop units in a louvred screen and a water tank.
